newsitem.title: USA: Henkel still interested in Loctite deal.
newsitem.headline: Henkel still interested in Loctite deal.

text.p: Henkel KGaA said Tuesday it was disappointed at Loctite Corp's decision spurning the its $57.75 a share bid, but remains "highly interested" in entering into a negotiated transaction.

Henkel's response to an action by a Loctite special committee not to recommend acceptance of the bid to Loctite shareholders was contained a letter the Germany company sent to the panel on Tuesday, November 19. A copy of the letter was attached to a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission.
In the letter, Henkel said it was prepared to meet with the special committee and its advisers "promptly" to accomplish its goal toward a negotiated deal.
Henkel, which made the bid for the 65 percent stake in the company it does not alrady own, said Loctite's decision to seek a buyer was an "important step" in furthering the interest of shareholders.
Henkel said it expected to be contacted by Loctite's advisers, who were instructed by the U.S. company to contact potential buyers.
